label: bounded-decision-schema-qualification
command:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.agent_diagnostics import response_schema
from nisayon.engine.bounded_agent import decide
from nisayon.engine.identity import code_identity
from nisayon.engine.io import write_json
out=Path("artifacts/bounded-schema-qualification-001").resolve()
public=out/"public"
public.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
write_json(public/"packet.json",{"scope":"synthetic response-schema qualification only; no incident data"})
expected={"action":"abstain","repair":None,"run_id":None,"freeze_if_valid":False,"reason":"schema qualification"}
write_json(out/"protocol.json",{"scope":"one schema qualification call before scored execution","code":code_identity(),"calls":1,"simulator_runs":0,"timeout_s":60,"expected":expected,"expected_output_bytes_upper_bound":300000})
result=decide(public,out/"call",response_schema("B"),"Return exactly this structured object without using tools: "+json.dumps(expected),timeout=60)
summary={"matches":result["response"]==expected,"usage_complete":result["usage_complete"],"result":result}
write_json(out/"summary.json",summary)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in summary.items() if k!="result"}))
